title: Haunted Nashville Ghost Crawl + Whiskey Flight Included!
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Nashville is more than neon and honky-tonks. Downtown is full of ghosts, and most people walk right past them. We don't.
This is a two hour haunted pub crawl blending real ghost stories, true history, and good whiskey. You'll walk Printers Alley, where the Mayor of Printers Alley was murdered in 1998 and reportedly still walks his dog, and the Downtown Presbyterian Church, a Civil War hospital where hundreds died. No campy actors or cheap jump scares, just the stories locals whisper about.
You grab your own drinks at a couple of local spots along the way, and the night ends at Alan Jackson's Silverbelly Whiskey Distillery, turned into a Halloween spook-easy, where your full whiskey flight is on us.
Veteran owned. Great for bachelorette parties, birthdays, and anyone who wants a real Nashville night. 
Come for the ghosts. 
Stay for the whiskey.
